verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a crash-report dialog, a user-feedback widget, or any way to attach end-user feedback to a specific error event. The only nearby mention is a 3.3.0 'Feedback survey' release headline. It gives no indication that the survey collects end-user feedback tied to error events, and the general Sentry API-compatibility claim does not establish this specific capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can collect user feedback — a crash-report dialog or feedback widget — attached to the exact error event the user hit
